::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Febry 26th 1876  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 11
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

Could you give me any idea what is the[value of my copy rights](organizations/other_160.qmd), I do not mean that I want to part with them, but it would be convenient to me to know what is likely to be the full value of my property, and what I could raise by them in case of need[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Endorsed  'See my letter. Feb 29/1'.
[^2]: This question is likely to have been prompted by anxiety about the financial situation of CMY's brother [Julian](people/person_1624.qmd).
